gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.map.heard: Open the floor plan. It only shows what your cast has seen. So go and see things. Right click to set a marker. Middle click to ping. Your friends will pretend they saw it.

gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.skip.heard: Fair enough. The good ones never listen either. I'll be in this booth if you change your mind. I'm always in this booth.

gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.stairs.heard: The way down is a stairwell with a red curtain. The curtain stays shut for the first quarter of the airtime, so the audience gets its money's worth. A few are guarded by a boss. Those open when the boss stops breathing.

gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.topics.heard: Short version then. Pick one. I talk slow but I talk short.

gaffer/npc.hint.coins.text.heard: Spend them at the vending machines, in green rooms, and at any shop you find.

gaffer/npc.hint.crate.text.heard: Sealed until you reach an unboxing booth in a green room, suspense is in the contract.

gaffer/npc.hint.green_room.text.heard: No monsters. No damage. Free Sophos. The unboxing booth is here, too. Breathe."

gaffer/npc.hint.stairs_closed.text.heard: Stairwells open after the first quarter of the airtime. The audience wants a show first.

gaffer/npc.hint.ten_minutes.text.heard: Find a stairwell before the set strike. Open the floor plan.

hollis/npc.dlg.hollis.offer.heard: Hall is grad. Camera, 40 years behind the lens and never once in front of it. There's an old shrine on this lot with the best light in the dungeon. I can't walk that far anymore. stand in it for me?

marigold/npc.dlg.marigold.offer.heard: Mind the seedlings, dear. Marigold, thatch. I ran this greenhouse for 30 seasons before the plant started running it. The pollinators have taken my orchid house. Molds in the lamps, drones in the roses. Would you thin them out? Eight should teach them manners.

mott/npc.dlg.mott.offer.heard: Change tokens no my penny change booth 22 years never short by a coin One district of this hall has a boss who runs up a tab and never pays My till is crying if you could close his account permanently. I would make it worth your while

network/rules.objective.casting.refuse.heard: uncredited extras do not go downstairs. Sign a role at the casting office first.

odessa/npc.dlg.odessa.offer.heard: Oh, a crawler. I am Odessaquil. I wrote this town, you know. Every facade on this lot started in my notebook. I have lost my lucky pen. Somebody packed it into a prop crate in this town. Without it, I cannot write a single line, and that is terrible for a writer!

orrin/npc.dlg.orrin.offer.heard: Watch your step, the floor sweats, or in glace, refrigeration. One district's boss is standing right on the hatch of the main compressor. If I cannot service it, the whole vault freezes solid, more solid. Could you move the boss along, for good?"

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.offer.heard: Hard hat on, please. Autoline brass, boiler inspector, seasonal. The stokers have not let me near a single boiler all season. They keep shoveling, the needles keep climbing, and I keep writing, see attached in a log book with nothing attached. Thin them out for me?

pell/npc.dlg.pell.offer.heard: Careful where you step. That bridge is made of light and it is not insured. Pell Brightwater. Cables. One district boss is sitting on my main junction. I cannot rewire a thing until it is gone. Would you take it off air?

props/npc.dlg.props.hello.heard: Bombs, smoke, flashpots, the odd floor plan. Point the loud end away from your face. That's the whole safety course.

props/npc.dlg.props.who.heard: May tallow, props, and pyro. I still have nine fingers and both eyebrows. In my line of work, that's a pension.

props/voice.vendor.props.buy.0.heard: Lovely. Point the loud end away from your face.

props/voice.vendor.props.buy.1.heard: Good one that, lights first time, every time. Almost.

props/voice.vendor.props.buy.2.heard: The monsters are going to hate you!

props/voice.vendor.props.buy.3.heard: Keep it dry, keep it cool, and don't sit on it.

props/voice.vendor.props.passby.0.heard: Bomb, smoke, flashpots, things that go bang, goin' cheap.

props/voice.vendor.props.passby.1.heard: Hey, you look like someone who wants to blow something up.

props/voice.vendor.props.passby.2.heard: Floor plans and fireworks. Get them here. Mine the sparks.

props/voice.vendor.props.passby.3.heard: Come on, have a look. Nothing in here has gone off today. Yet.

props/voice.vendor.props.poor.0.heard: Bit short, mate. Explosives cost money. Hospitals cost more.

props/voice.vendor.props.poor.1.heard: Not enough coin. Come back after a good bang.

props/voice.vendor.props.poor.2.heard: No coins, no boom, that's the whole economy.

props/voice.vendor.props.poor.3.heard: Oh, no credit mate. Last bloke I give credit to is still smoldering.

tilda/npc.dlg.tilda.offer.heard: Shut the door, love, you are letting the warm out. Tilda Frostwick, a coach for every rap party this vault ever froze. The old buffet got up and walked off with my canteen. Turkeys, swans, the leftovers, especially the leftovers. Would you clear out eight of them?

vesna/npc.dlg.vesna.offer.heard: Mind the cables, they bite now. Vesna Halloran, night shift on the transmitters. 30 years, never once off air. And the static started crawling out of my sets. Snow, wraiths, things you only see under a lamp. Would you clear eight of them for me?

wardrobe/npc.dlg.wardrobe.hello.heard: Armor is just costume with ambition. Let's find you something that fits, if not something that flatters.

wardrobe/npc.dlg.wardrobe.who.heard: Ambrose Seem, Head of Wardrobe. I dressed every season's cast. Most of them twice, once going in once for the memorial reel.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.buy.0.heard: There. Now you look like you meant to come here.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.buy.1.heard: a sensible choice. I'm almost proud.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.buy.2.heard: It suits you. Well, it suits the monsters less.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.buy.3.heard: wear it with confidence, or at least wear it the right way round.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.passby.0.heard: You can't go out there dressed like that. Come here at once.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.passby.1.heard: That armor is a cry for help. I can answer it.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.passby.2.heard: fittings, alterations, and honest opinions, mostly the opinions

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.passby.3.heard: A crawler in rags is a crawler and trouble, step inside.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.poor.0.heard: Quality cost coins. You have, at a glance, not enough of either.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.poor.1.heard: Alas, taste is free, the armor isn't.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.poor.2.heard: No coins, no fitting, those are the rules of fashion.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.poor.3.heard: Put it down gently. It's worth more than your purse.

wren/npc.dlg.wren.offer.heard: Shh, the projector is warming up. Ren Holloway, night projectionist. Nobody watches at night, but somebody has to run the reels. Except the reels have started running themselves. Film strips in the basins, crabs in the canisters, a wisp in booth three. Could you stop eight of them before the whole collection swims off?

emcee/orientation.audience.emcee.heard: And here's our newest crawler, showing off before the doors even open. I love them already. Contractually.

fennick/npc.dlg.fennick.offer.heard: Careful, that floor is wet. That is me. Fennec moss, sprinklers. Something enormous has grown over the water mains of one district. Every time I go near the pipes, it tries to eat my wrench. If you could remove it, permanently, the valves would thank you.

gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.wing_rehearsal.heard: questions already? Good. Most people save them for the funeral. Shall I carry on? Or do you know your way around?"

gaffer/orientation.arms.0.heard: The arms rack. One of everything the props department trusts you with Take something off the wall

gaffer/orientation.arms.back.heard: You've had your weapon from me already. These all go back on the rack.

gaffer/orientation.arms.block.heard: My sparring partner swings back, raise a shield when his arm goes up.

gaffer/orientation.arms.block.again.heard: take the buckler from the rack. Raise it when his arm comes up.

gaffer/orientation.arms.charged.heard: Now wait for the swing to fill. One full blow beats three quick taps.

gaffer/orientation.arms.charged.again.heard: Watch the little bar under your crosshair. Let it fill, then swing.

gaffer/orientation.arms.done.heard: Keep the one in your hand. I'll have the rest back. Props. Counts everything.

gaffer/orientation.arms.hit.heard: Good. Now the dummy. He doesn't hit back. That's his best quality.

gaffer/orientation.arms.hit.again.heard: A wooden fellow on the mark, give him a whack, he's been asking for it.

gaffer/orientation.arms.keep.again.heard: Whatever's in your hand when you walk on is yours. The rest goes back on the rack.

gaffer/orientation.arms.kind.bow.heard: a bow. Keeps the trouble at a distance. Mind the arrows. They're not free.

gaffer/orientation.arms.kind.one_handed.heard: a short sword. quick and light. and it leaves a hand free for a shield.

gaffer/orientation.arms.kind.shield.heard: a buckler. Raise it, and most of what comes at you stops at the wood.

gaffer/orientation.arms.kind.thrown.heard: throwing knives, fast and quiet, and you have to go and fetch them.

gaffer/orientation.arms.kind.two_handed.heard: Oh greatsword, slow to swing, and anything it hits remembers it.

gaffer/orientation.arms.rack.again.heard: the rack on the wall. Look at a weapon and take it.

gaffer/orientation.arms.shoot.heard: Last one, the target pass the rope, hit it with a shot or a throw.

gaffer/orientation.arms.shoot.again.heard: the bow or the knives from the rack. Stand behind the rope and aim at the target.

gaffer/orientation.audience.1.heard: Jump and hit the dummy as you come down. Show them something.

gaffer/orientation.audience.again.heard: Jump and strike while you come down. Timing is everything in show business.

gaffer/orientation.audience.done.heard: Hear that, hype makes fans and fans send crates, standing around makes neither.

gaffer/orientation.dress.0.heard: Dress rehearsal, one of the props department's rats, don't worry, it's at its lunch.

gaffer/orientation.dress.1.heard: Here it comes. Hit it until I call cut. I'll call cut.

gaffer/orientation.dress.again.heard: It's small, and the bites keep hitting it until I call cut.

gaffer/orientation.dress.cut.heard: CUT. That'll do You got the hang of it.

gaffer/orientation.dress.done.heard: Through the curtain is tonight's set. Whatever they build out there, the rules don't change.

gaffer/orientation.green.0.heard: a green room. No monster gets in, nothing hurts you, and the crew keeps the kettle on.

gaffer/orientation.green.buy.heard: Here's a few coins. The vending machine takes them. Buy yourself something.

gaffer/orientation.green.buy.again.heard: the machine by the wall, use it, pick something, pay.

gaffer/orientation.green.done.heard: Every green room has a booth and a machine like these, rest there when you can.

gaffer/orientation.green.eat.heard: Now eat your drink something. You'll do a lot of both down there.

gaffer/orientation.green.eat.again.heard: Popcorn. A potion or a bandage. Hold it in your hand and keep using it.

gaffer/orientation.green.stash.heard: Your stash travels with you, open it and put something in.

gaffer/orientation.green.stash.again.heard: Open your stash, shift click anything from your bag into it.

gaffer/orientation.magic.0.heard: A little magic. I've put a spell on your bar. Every crawler gets one.

gaffer/orientation.magic.1.heard: cast it at the target on the riser.

gaffer/orientation.magic.2.heard: The blue bar is your mana. Spells drink it, and it fills back up on its own.

gaffer/orientation.magic.3.heard: The dark sweep on the slot is the cool-down. Wait it out. Nagging doesn't help.

gaffer/orientation.magic.again.heard: Look at the target on the riser and cast, the spell bar sits over your hot bar.

gaffer/orientation.map.0.heard: Uh, floor plan. I've had the crew pencil in the first room and a way down.

gaffer/orientation.map.2.heard: Right click the stairs symbol for a waypoint. The little map in the corner points the way.

gaffer/orientation.map.open.again.heard: Open the floor plan, it only shows what your cast is seeing, plus my pencil.

gaffer/orientation.map.waypoint.again.heard: the symbol with the steps, right click it on the plan.

gaffer/orientation.prizes.0.heard: prize crates, you win them down there, bosses, fans, achievements, they stay sealed.

gaffer/orientation.prizes.1.heard: crates only open at an unboxing booth. Here's one for practice. Open it.

gaffer/orientation.prizes.again.heard: a booth with the bulbs, use it and press open.

gaffer/orientation.prizes.done.heard: That's the whole trick when them on camera, open them backstage.

gaffer/orientation.sheet.0.heard: The Mirror Wall. Every new crawler stops here to check their face. Check your sheet instead.

gaffer/orientation.sheet.1.heard: Open your crawler sheet. I've slipped you a free point. Spend it.

gaffer/orientation.sheet.2.heard: Strength hits harder. Agility hits faster. Vitality keeps you standing

gaffer/orientation.sheet.3.heard: Mind feeds your magic, charm works the crowd in the prices, skills grow by doing

gaffer/orientation.sheet.again.heard: Open your crawler sheet. The page with your name on it. The little plus spends the point

gaffer/orientation.sheet.lent.heard: That point was on loan this time. Yours went in the first time round.

gaffer/orientation.wardrobe.0.heard: Wardrobe. The locker's got something better than what you've got on. Its card will say so.

gaffer/orientation.wardrobe.again.heard: the locker by the wall, take the piece, then put it on.

gaffer/orientation.wardrobe.done.heard: There. Better already. A green arrow on a card means an upgrade. Trust the arrow.

gaffer/orientation.wardrobe.taken.heard: That one. See the green arrow on its card? Hold it in your hand and put it on.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.0.heard: Over here, new talent, on the tape, if you please.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.1.heard: I'm the Gaffer, 40 seasons hanging lights on this show. I've seen a lot of first days.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.2.heard: This is the rehearsal wing back here. The cameras are off out there. They never are.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.3.heard: The show is simple, 10 floors down, every floor is set, every set on the clock.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.4.heard: Find the stairs before the clock runs out. At zero, the crew strikes the set, with you on it.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.5.heard: die down there and your run is over. What you carried stays behind in your remains.

gaffer/orientation.welcome.6.heard: your cast can pick through them. Try not to be the one they pick through. Right! Follow me!

gaffer/orientation.welcome.again.heard: The tape, the yellow bit on the floor, go and stand on it.

barnaby/npc.dlg.barnaby.after.heard: If they ever reboot this town, I'm putting you in the credits, small font, but in!

barnaby/npc.dlg.barnaby.ready.heard: Not a peep from over there. Lovely work. Textbook. I'd have added a backflip, but that's just me.

barnaby/npc.dlg.barnaby.thanks.heard: Hear your fee. Stunt pay minus nothing because I'm not a monster.

barnaby/npc.dlg.barnaby.wait.heard: Still hearing noises from that set. Noises are bad? Silence is good. Make it silent.

barnaby/npc.dlg.barnaby.yes.heard: Excellent! Go in loud! Fall like you mean it! Every last one of them out, please!

bram/npc.dlg.bram.after.heard: The tide comes in on a schedule. Gages on the walls tell you when, nobody ever reads them. Be somebody.

bram/npc.dlg.bram.ready.heard: The drip has stopped. Well, one drip has stopped. That is a personal best for this archive.

bram/npc.dlg.bram.thanks.heard: Your fee, in coins that have only been underwater twice, now if you will excuse me, I have nine hundred other leaks.

bram/npc.dlg.bram.wait.heard: Still dripping over there. I can hear it from here. I can hear every drip on this floor.

bram/npc.dlg.bram.yes.heard: Splendid. Turn a sluice wheel on the way if you pass one. Dry floors fight better. Ask anyone.

concessions/voice.vendor.concessions.bro.heard: Take your time, love. The clock won't.
You've read that menu twice. The popcorn's good. Trust me.
Still looking? It's all edible, mostly.
Hungry crawlers make bad choices, love. Pick something before you get worse.

concessions/voice.vendor.concessions.sel.heard: I'll take it! Don't ask me what I'll do with it!
Secondhand, slightly dented, like most of my customers.
Fair price for a fair crawler. Off you go!
I'll find a use for that, probably as a tray.

dez/npc.dlg.dez.after.heard: Next experiment, what happens if you feed the furnace a sponsor contract? Do not tell anyone.

kept.heard: Is it perfect? Look at that, soggy all the way through. Hand them over.

dez/npc.dlg.dez.thanks.heard: Result. It stokes because it is stuffed with budget reports. I am not joking. Hear your reward!

dez/npc.dlg.dez.wait.heard: Any briquettes? The damn kind? I have a beaker ready and absolutely no supervision!

dez/npc.dlg.dez.yes.heard: Brilliant! Damp ones only. Try ones are boring. Also, um, do not stand near the squibs.

emcee/arrive.backlot.1.heard: the back lock under a painted sky. The sun is plywood, the clouds are cotton wool, and the neighbors are always watching.

emcee/arrive.backlot.2.heard: Welcome to the backlot where the neighbors are friendly, the paint is fresh, and the monsters are union!

emcee/arrive.boiler_room.1.heard: And now, the Boiler Room. It is a little warm in here, so please, sweat photogenically. The cameras love a glow.

emcee/arrive.boiler_room.2.heard: Clock in, crawler. This is the boiler room. Watch the gauges, respect the pressure, and never lick a pipe.

emcee/arrive.cold_storage.1.heard: Welcome to cold storage where the show keeps its leftovers, including the leftovers that walk.

emcee/arrive.cold_storage.2.heard: Cold storage, today's forecast freezing with a strong chance of whiteouts and regret.

emcee/arrive.dead_air.1.heard: Welcome to G'dadar! where the platforms float in the void below is not a figure of speech. Ugh!

kept.heard: The signal is weak, the dark is thick, and something out there loves television. Stay in the light

emcee/arrive.high_roller_hall.2.heard: Welcome to the High Roller Hall. Pssst! The altars in the green rooms take bets on your next fight. Win fast.

kept.heard: from the overgrowth, our greenhouse. Everything here is organic, including whatever eats you.

emcee/arrive.overgrowth.2.heard: Welcome to the ova growth. If the air turns purple eat a clear cap find a sprinkler or find a sofa

emcee/arrive.prop_storage.1.heard: And now, prop storage fully healed and freshly dusted. Mind the practical effects. They are very practical.

emcee/arrive.sunken_archive.1.heard: The Sunken Archive. The water comes in, the water goes out. Keep an eye on the gauges.

emcee/arrive.sunken_archive.2.heard: Ahoy crawler! The Sunken Archive welcomes you aboard. Swimming is permitted. Breathing underwater is not.

emcee/arrive.understage.1.heard: The under-stage, low ceilings, loose cables, and monsters who miss their cue. No special rules down here, just you and them.

emcee/arrive.understage.2.heard: Down we go, the understage. It is dark, it is damp, and it is the cheapest set we own. Break a leg, not literally.

emcee/boss_kill.3.heard: Goodbye boss, that scene was written with style and a lot of violence.

emcee/boss_kill.4.heard: The crowd goes wild, the bosses beaten. Prize crates for the winners, therapy for the bosses family.

emcee/boss_kill.5.heard: The boss has been removed from the call sheet, a ratings triumph.

emcee/carried.0.heard: While you were away, your cast moved on. You wake up where they are. Continuity is our passion.

emcee/cast_join.0.heard: Haha, somebody knew just walked through the curtain, your cast grows, and so does the catering bill.

emcee/cast_join.1.heard: Please welcome a new face to the cast! Remember, share the loot, but not to blame.

emcee/cast_join.2.heard: Another crawler has joined the season, more friends, more fans, more ways for things to go wrong.

emcee/cast_join.3.heard: New Face Alert. The audience loves a team up. The monsters love a buffet.

emcee/cast_join.4.heard: A new crawler is on set. Say hello and please stay out of each other's camera angles.

emcee/cast_join.5.heard: Breaking casting news, somebody new is in, our ratings model predicts screaming together.

emcee/dead_air.2.heard: Nothing has happened for a while. Our viewers are switching to the Cooking Channel.

kept.heard: Ooooh, is this a nature documentary now? Please move, please.

emcee/dead_air.4.heard: Our sponsor, Snoozebrite Pillows, thanks you for this very restful segment. Nobody else does.

emcee/dead_air.5.heard: Dead air detected, in 30 seconds we start playing your baby photos.

emcee/death_boss.3.heard: A crawler fell for the boss, a fight to remember unless you were the one it fell on.

emcee/death_boss.4.heard: Bots wins. It has removed a crawler from the call sheet.

emcee/death_boss.5.heard: A crawler gave the boss everything. The boss took it, and then some.

emcee/death_drown.0.heard: A crawler forgot to come up for air. The aquarium scene is cancelled.

emcee/death_drown.1.heard: A crawler sank like a script nobody wanted to read.

emcee/death_drown.2.heard: Water 1. Crawler Zero. Swimming lessons are not in the budget.

emcee/death_explosion.0.heard: A crawler was in the blast zone. The blast zone was in their way.

emcee/death_explosion.1.heard: Boom! A crawler has been stuttered across the set. The cleaning crew is not amused.

emcee/death_explosion.2.heard: A crawler exploded out of the season. The sound team calls it their best work.

emcee/death_fall.3.heard: A crawler took a shortcut downwards. It was short. It was not a cut.

emcee/death_fall.4.heard: A crawler jumped. The landing did not go as rehearsed.

emcee/death_fall.5.heard: Tumble too far for one of our crawlers. Our stunt coordinator has resigned out of sympathy.

emcee/death_fire.0.heard: A crawler got a little too close to the pyrotechnics, the effects were very special.

emcee/death_fire.1.heard: A crawler went up in flames. Our fire marshal is riding a strongly worded leaflet.

emcee/death_fire.2.heard: A crawler was roasted and not by the critics.

emcee/death_fire.3.heard: Too hot to handle. A crawler has left the show in a puff of smoke.

emcee/death_monster.5.heard: A monster took down one of our crawlers. That is one for the blooper reel and one for the obituary.

emcee/death_monster.6.heard: We regret to announce that a crawler has been canceled by a monster. Reruns are available.

emcee/death_other.0.heard: One of our crawlers has been written out of the show. The writers are as surprised as you are.

emcee/death_other.1.heard: A crawler is no longer with the cast. Cause unclear. Content, excellent.

emcee/death_other.2.heard: We have lost a crawler, not in the dramatic sense, in the literal sense.

emcee/death_own_bomb.2.heard: own goal. A crawler blew themselves out of the show. The audience could not look away.

emcee/death_set_strike.2.heard: crawler missed the stairs and caught the strike, timing is everything.

emcee/descend.5.heard: A crawler left for the next floor, somebody wave, somebody always forgets to wave.

network/rules.cycle.tide.high.say.3.heard: The tide is in, walkways stay dry, basins do not. The network does not provide armbands.

network/rules.cycle.tide.low.say.heard: low water in the archive. The basins are dry and whatever sank is lying in plain sight. Shop while it lasts.

network/rules.cycle.tide.low.say.1.heard: The tide is out, the basins are walkable, and the network encourages light looting.

network/rules.cycle.tide.low.say.2.heard: Low water? Everything that fell into the basins is now on display. Limited time only.

network/rules.cycle.tide.low.say.3.heard: the basins have drained. Go down, grab with glitters, and come back up before the schedule says otherwise.

kept.heard: but tide is turning. Hear the drains bubbling? Get out of the basins or learn to hold your breath.

network/rules.cycle.tide.rising.say.1.heard: The water is coming back. Climb out of the basins now. The drains are not a staircase.

network/rules.cycle.tide.rising.say.2.heard: rising tide. Anyone still at the bottom of a basin? This is your final courtesy notice.

network/rules.cycle.tide.rising.say.3.heard: the drains are bubbling. In a moment, the basins are pools again. Please leave at your own pace, quickly.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.calm.say.heard: the vents settle down. Enjoy the calm. It is on a timer like everything else here.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.calm.say.1.heard: the blizzard is over. Visibility restored? Your cold meter, sadly, is not.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.calm.say.2.heard: calm and cold storage. Warm up at a brazier while the vents are resting.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.calm.say.3.heard: The air clears. The network reminds you that the next whiteout is already scheduled.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.gusts.say.heard: The vents are rattling. A whiteout in 10 seconds. Find a fire or a green room.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.gusts.say.1.heard: Gusts from the vents, 10 seconds to a whiteout. Head for a bracer now.

kept.heard: Pure the rattle, that is 10 seconds of warning. A fire or a green room, your choice.

network/rules.cycle.whiteout.gusts.say.3.heard: wide out in 10 seconds. If you are not near a fire, you are about to wish you were.

Whiteout 30 seconds of nothing at all in the cold doubles. Stay by the heat.

network/rules.shrine.cannot.heard: You cannot pay for that right now. The sponsors are disappointed, but not surprised.

odessa/npc.dlg.odessa.ready.heard: Is that my pen? It is! Oh, I could kiss you, but it's unprofessional!

odessa/npc.dlg.odessa.yes.heard: blessed you. Check every crate and locker over there. It's silver. It's dented. It's mine.

odile/npc.dlg.odile.thanks.heard: Your winnings, do not gamble them away, or do it is your show.

orrin/npc.dlg.orrin.ready.heard: Hatch Clear, Compressor Hummin, you have saved the vault from becoming an even colder vault.

orrin/npc.dlg.orrin.thanks.heard: your fee. Keep it somewhere warm.

orrin/npc.dlg.orrin.wait.heard: The hatch is still blocked. The gauges are going places. Gauges should not go.

orrin/npc.dlg.orrin.yes.heard: Good. Take rickets from the bins as you go and keep the braziers fed. A burning brazier is worth three coats.

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.ready.heard: Quiet boilers, I can hear the rivets again. Lovely. Section nine, subsection four, passed with a crawler.

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.thanks.heard: your fee and a stamp in my logbook. The stamp is worth more. Do not tell accounting.

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.wait.heard: The gauges are still climbing, that means the stokers are still shoveling, that means you are still needed.

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.yes.heard: Eight should do it. Mind the striped corridors on the way. They vent at every peak. I have written that down too.

pell/npc.dlg.pell.ready.heard: Junction's clear. Lights are coming back up all over the district. You're free.

pell/npc.dlg.pell.thanks.heard: If you fall, the show puts you back at the edge. It is just your health that does not come back up with you.

pell/npc.dlg.pell.wait.heard: Hmm, junction still blocked. I'm just sitting here coiling cable. Again.

pell/npc.dlg.pell.yes.heard: Thanks. And keep away from the edges when a boom lancer lowers its pull. The drop costs more than you think.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.after.heard: I got a line today, it was look out, I said it beautifully.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.ready.heard: It's quiet. I can walk to the craft table again. You're my hero. Don't tell anyone. They'll want a photo.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.thanks.heard: I saved this for an emergency. This feels like the opposite of one. Take it.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.wait.heard: I can hear the flashes. Can you hear the flashes? You can't hear flashes, but I can.

vesna/npc.dlg.vesna.wait.heard: I can still hear them hissing in the sets. Go on, love.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.browse.0.heard: You're allowed to touch the fabric. You're not allowed to live here.

wardrobe/voice.vendor.wardrobe.sell.3.heard: Leave it on the counter. Not on the good counter.

wren/npc.dlg.wren.after.heard: If the director's cut ever splits in two, follow the faster half. The slower one is only pretending.

wren/npc.dlg.wren.thanks.heard: You fee and a ticket for the first screening when this floor dries out. It never dries out, so keep the ticket as a souvenir.

wren/npc.dlg.wren.wait.heard: The counter on my projector still says they are loose. It is a very honest counter.

wren/npc.dlg.wren.yes.heard: Thank you. Mind the wists. When the line of light points at you, step out of it. Then hit them while they reload.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.offer.heard: Good evening. Bethany Fenn, under footman. 50 years in service and not one day off. There is a wing of this house I have not been allowed into since the cameras came. Where the rules it now does not care for staff Would you see them out for good?

emcee/arrive.hollowmere_manor.0.heard: Hollow me a manor! The network bought it for the ratings and could not sell it again. Mind the candles. They are the only light on your side.

emcee/mob.intro.the_curator.heard: Every collection needs a keeper, and this one wants you on his wall, the Curator. When he lifts an empty frame, it is for you! Break your friends out!

agnes/npc.dlg.agnes.after.heard: A hearth will light a taper for you, too. Fire is fire, dear, whatever it is, burning!

agnes/npc.dlg.agnes.ready.heard: Quiet at last. You can hear the clock again. Here, take this, and a box of my best.

agnes/npc.dlg.agnes.thanks.heard: If a room goes dark, the sideboards always hold a taper or two. I fill them every evening. Somebody has to.

agnes/npc.dlg.agnes.wait.heard: I can still hear them sighing in the walls. Keep a taper in your pocket.

agnes/npc.dlg.agnes.yes.heard: Oh, bless you! Fight them by the candle's mind. In the dark your blade goes straight through them, and that only makes them laugh.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.after.heard: The clock in the tower can be turned about by hand, you know. Midnight in this house is best avoided.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.ready.heard: The wing is free, after all these years. Allow me, it is the least the household can do.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.thanks.heard: If you meet Mr. Quietly, do give him my regards. Then hit him very hard.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.wait.heard: The wing is still occupied, I gather. I shall wait. I am very good at waiting.

bellamy/npc.dlg.bellamy.yes.heard: Very good. A word of advice. Whatever rings for help cut its cord. A bell that cannot ring calls nobody.

emcee/arrive.hollowmere_manor.1.heard: Welcome to Hollow Mirror Manor, where the furniture moves and the portraits follow you round the room. Keep a taper handy.

emcee/arrive.hollowmere_manor.2.heard: Hollow Mere Manor. Lovely old house. Drafty. Haunted. The previous owners never actually left.

emcee/mob.phase.the_curator.2.heard: The curator is running out of wall space, he frames faster now.

host/show.interview.q.31.heard: Oh, what would you change about the show?

host/show.interview.q.32.heard: Last question, why should the audience keep cheering for you?

network/show.sponsor.refuse.dropped.heard: You dropped a sponsor this season. Word gets around. Nobody else is calling.

network/show.sponsor.refuse.green_room.heard: Heh. Contracts are only torn up in a green room. Camera's off. Tempers cool.

network/show.sponsor.refuse.none.heard: you have no contract to drop. Commitment issues noted.

network/show.sponsor.refuse.not_offered.heard: That sponsor never offered you anything. Nice try.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.after.heard: The producer's last act is the cancellation. When the clock shows, stop being careful and finish him. I wrote that line too.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.offer.heard: Add a reader, Quill Hardigan, I write the cue cards. Every line the champions say, I wrote first. One of them has gone off script and the network blames me. Beat the champion who is improvising and my script holds for the finale.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.ready.heard: Back on script, you have no idea what that does for a writer's blood pressure.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.thanks.heard: Your fee and a card with your name on it. Keep it. One day it will be worth something. Probably.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.wait.heard: Still improvising I can hear it from here, the grammar is atrocious.

quill/npc.dlg.quill.yes.heard: Splendid! The cards say the returning champion copies whatever hits it. The cards are never wrong. Mostly.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.after.heard: Keep your hype up out there. When the house loves you, it throws flowers. When it doesn't, you'll know.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.ready.heard: Behind the rope, all of them. That is the quietest this floor has been all season.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.thanks.heard: Your fee from the floor budget. Do not tell the producer he thinks the floor budget is a myth.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.wait.heard: Still too many foam fingers on my floor. I can see them from the gallery.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.yes.heard: thank you. One note, superfans get braver in a pack. Split them up and the hype man drains your hype so he goes first.

emcee/mob.intro.lady_hollowmere.heard: The ball ended a hundred years ago and nobody told her. Lady Holomir, keep off her line when she turns, fight her in candlelight, and those chandeliers are not bolted down.

emcee/mob.intro.the_long_night.heard: Every evening in this house ends the same way. The twelfth stroke. Each strike of the clock changes the house. Turn the clock faces back and keep midnight away.

emcee/world.place.hollowmere_manor.rule.heard: candlelight. Candles burn down while you fight. Away from a flame the restless cannot be hurt, and the dark creeps up on you, and the cold gas lamps do not count. Relight the candles with tapers from the sideboards and hearths.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.brrrisk.plug..heard: That chill was brought to you by brisk mint gum. Your breath is now legally a weather event.
Verisk mit gum, one piece freshens, two pieces freeze, three pieces void the warranty.
ice cold. Brisk asks crawlers not to stick the gum under the furniture. It is a set.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.dashbasket.pl.heard: That entrance was brought to you by Dash Basket Curriers. You arrived. The monsters are pending.
Dash Basket-teriors! We knock once. Then we are already inside!
First through the door again, Dash Basket reminds you that tips are appreciated and rarely received.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.farsquint.plu.heard: That shot was brought to you by Farsquint Optics. Squintless, hit more.
far-squint optics, because the best seat in the house is far away from the monster.
A clean-headed range. Farsquint reminds you that the lens cap comes off first.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.fineprint.plu.heard: That new miss was brought to you by Fine Print Mutual. Clin denied, but thank you for calling.
Fine print mutual insurance, we cover everything except the things that happen.
Still standing? Fine for Inter would like to point out clause 9, paragraph 12. Nobody reads it.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.kaboodle.plug.heard: That bang was brought to you by Kaboodle Novelty Fireworks. Please stand further back than that.
Kaboodle Novelty Fireworks, the only product in the shop that comes with an apology letter.
Boom, Kabuta would like to remind viewers that this is a trained professional. Allegedly.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.lacquerella.p.heard: That flourish was brought to you by Lacarella. Not a hair moved. Several monsters did.
Lacquerella hair lacquer, when the cameras find you, look like you meant it.
What a moment, Lacarella reminds viewers that the product is flammable and so is Ambition.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.magpie.plug.0.heard: That haul was brought to you by Magpie Savings and Vaults, interest rates as shiny as your loot.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.magpie.plug.1.heard: Magpie savings and vaults. If it glitters, we have a box for it.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.magpie.plug.2.heard: Ooh, shiny! Magpie reminds you that past halls are no guarantee of future halls.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.patchwork.plu.heard: That gulp was brought to you by Patchwork Pharmacy. Side effects include living longer.
Patchwork Pharmacy. Read the label, then drink it anyway, like a professional.
Bottoms up. Patchwork reminds you that the bottle is not a throwing weapon. Usually.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.smoulderby.pl.heard: That blaze was brought to you by Smolderby Candles, now in burnt toast and singed eyebrow.
Smell the big candles, light one, light two, light the whole floor, we do not judge.
A fiery finish. Smoldery reminds you never to leave a candle or a crawler unattended.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.voltwhistle.p.heard: That zap was brought to you by Vault Whistle Power Banks. Please do not lick the terminals.
volt whistle power banks. We put the shock in shocking value.
Electrifying, Voltwhistle reminds you that the smell of ozone is part of the experience.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.wobblewick.pl.heard: That trick was brought to you by Wobblewick Toys. Small parts, big consequences.
Wobblewood Toy Company. Every toy tested on at least one brave volunteer.
Nice throw, Wobblewick reminds you to collect your toys after playtime. The monsters will not.

emcee/mob.phase.leading_man.2.heard: His hair is out of place, somebody is going to pay for that and he has picked you.

emcee/mob.phase.the_long_night.1.heard: The 12th stroke weans itself up, something answers from the dark.

emcee/mob.phase.the_long_night.2.heard: The hands are racing. The 12th stroke comes sooner and sooner.

emcee/arrive.high_roller_hall.1.heard: The High Roller Hall, ladies and gentlemen. Place your bets, mine the wheel, and let the twist spin.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.yes.heard: Thank you. H should do it. They talk to each other. They'll get the message.

emcee/arrive.sun_tomb.0.heard: The Sun Tomb. An old king built it to rest in. The network bought the rights to his rest. Turn the mirrors and let the daylight in.

emcee/mob.intro.mother_of_scarabs.heard: Every morning, she rolls the sun across the sky. In here, she rolls it at you, the mother of scarabs. Step aside from the desk or in it back.

emcee/mob.intro.the_bright_king.heard: He never left his throne, and he never liked the daylight. The Bright King himself, he walks only in the dark. Turn the mirrors, bring the sun in, and he burns.

emcee/mob.intro.the_excavator.heard: He bought the digging rights from the network for a song and he is not leaving without the King's gold. The excavator, when the grit falls, get out from under it!

emcee/mob.intro.the_vizier.heard: He kept the old king's seals for forty years and saw no reason to stop when the king did. The vizier who stayed, his life is in four jars. Beat their keepers, break the jars, or catch him in the sun.

emcee/world.place.sun_tomb.rule.heard: Sun Beams. Turn the bronze mirrors to throw the daylight across the room. A beam burns the wrapped, keeps the swarm away and warms you. Light every sun seal to open the stairs, deep sand slows you, and hides you if you crouch.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.offer.heard: Careful where you stand. The light is coming round. And it's Saba I keep the sun wells clear and the mirrors bright. and have done since before the cameras. The trouble is the wrapped. Every mirror I turn to the sun, they turn back to the wall. Would you put eight of them to rest for me?

emcee/arrive.sun_tomb.1.heard: Welcome to the Sun Tomb, where the sand is deep, the dead are wrapped, and the sunlight comes by appointment. Mind the mirrors.

emcee/arrive.sun_tomb.2.heard: The sun tomb, painted halls, buried halls, golden halls. The previous owner is still in residence, and so are his staff.

emcee/mob.phase.mother_of_scarabs.1.heard: The Mother of Scarabs calls her children, all of them, at once.

emcee/mob.phase.mother_of_scarabs.2.heard: She is rolling faster now, keep your feet and your timing.

emcee/mob.phase.the_bright_king.1.heard: The Bright King carves up his household, they are all wrapped, and none of them have aged well.

emcee/mob.phase.the_bright_king.2.heard: The king is turning the mirrors away himself now. Whoever turns them back had better be quick on their feet.

emcee/mob.phase.the_excavator.1.heard: The excavator has lit a fuse, several fuses, that is the opposite of a plan.

emcee/mob.phase.the_excavator.2.heard: The roof is coming down faster than he can dig. Somebody stop him before the tomb is a quarry.

emcee/mob.phase.the_vizier.1.heard: The Vizier calls his keepers back to their jaws. Loyal staff, unfortunately.

emcee/mob.phase.the_vizier.2.heard: Half his life is on the floor in pieces. The Vaziras cross now and he wants it back.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.after.heard: crouch in the deep sand if they are too many. They lose you there. Then, come out swinging in the sun.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.ready.heard: The halls are bright again, you did that. Here, for your trouble and a little of the king's gold that nobody will miss.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.thanks.heard: When a mirror will not throw the light, look up. If no well shines on it, it only carries light that another mirror brings it.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.wait.heard: Another mirror turned to the wall this morning. I can smell the linen from here.

hennet/npc.dlg.hennet.yes.heard: Good, fight them in the beams if you can. The daylight does half the work, and it never asks for wages.

mira/npc.dlg.mira.offer.heard: Huh, don't mind me, I'm just sittin' on my shovel. Mira Kask, Dig Hand. Was a Dig Hand. The boss of one of these districts kept the payroll, and then kept it. I am owed six weeks. Would you go and get it back for me, by any means available?

mira/npc.dlg.mira.after.heard: If a lad with a torch spots you and runs, catch him. He is not running away, he is running for his friends.

mira/npc.dlg.mira.ready.heard: There it is, every coin, and some that were not mine, which I will look after carefully. Your share.

mira/npc.dlg.mira.thanks.heard: A tip from the trade, the robbers always run for the nearest door with the loot. Stand in it!

mira/npc.dlg.mira.wait.heard: Still waiting on my wages, I have counted the bricks in this wall twice.

mira/npc.dlg.mira.yes.heard: Ha ha ha! Lovely! If the roof starts dropping grid on you, move. That is not weather, that is somebody with a pick!

emcee/mob.intro.miss_direction.heard: From the front window of a shop that never opened, miss direction. Keep her in your sights. The moment you turn away, she rearranges the display.

emcee/remain_many.1.heard: Feel her names on the call sheet now. The tension in the studio is delicious.

emcee/rules.hint.floor4.heard: The boiler room. Yellow stripes on the floor means steam at every peak of the pressure cycle. Watch the gauges and the floor strip at the top of your screen.

emcee/rules.hint.floor5.heard: The sunken archive, the tide comes and goes, watch the tide gauges, and the floors strip at the top of your screen. Sunken basins fill at high water.

emcee/world.place.dead_air.rule.heard: Signal. Switch on every transmitter to open the stairs. Each calls a wave and makes monsters a level tougher. The void takes a good bite of your health.

gaffer/npc.dlg.gaffer.stats.heard: Every level gives you three points. In a green room open the crawler screen and put them where it hurts most. Strength, agility, vitality, mind or charm. Skills grow by doing. Hit things to get better at hitting things. Simple. Painful. But simple.

gaffer/npc.hint.level.text.heard: Three fresh stat points, spend them in a green room in the crawler screen.

gaffer/orientation.arms.technique.heard: Every weapon in this business has a trick of its own. Try yours on the canvas, fellow. His board keeps score.

gaffer/orientation.arms.technique.again.heard: Every weapon has a trick of its own, use it on the canvas, fellow, and watch.

gaffer/orientation.arms.technique.done.heard: That's the one. There's a fellow like him in every green room, for when you want to compare...

gaffer/orientation.audience.0.heard: The audience. Painted, but they still cheer. They love a bit of flair, and flair fills your hype.

gaffer/orientation.map.done.heard: Rooms you have seen fill in, green rooms are green. The step symbol is a stairwell, your way down.

odile/npc.dlg.odile.offer.heard: Cut the deck, darling, Odile Marchbank. Forty years at these tables and I never once dealt from the bottom. Now the lucky streak runs my old felt. Dice that change their faces, bats that steal your luck. Clear eight of them off my tables and I will owe you one.

pip/npc.dlg.pip.offer.heard: Shh. Are they gone? The photographers. They follow me everywhere. I'm Pitt Fernaby. Understudy to an understudy. One bad photo and I'm done. Could you... um... disparage a few of them?

rosalind/npc.dlg.rosalind.offer.heard: Darling, Rosalind Ambry, you'll have seen my films, everyone has, nobody admits it. I'm famished, and Concessions refuses to deliver. Two tubs of popcorn, darling, buttered, I'll make it worth your while.

announcer_ads/show.sponsor.crunchwell.pl.heard: That knockout was brought to you by Crunchwell Crisps, loud on purpose.
Quenchwell crisps, for fights that need a soundtrack. That one did.
This punch-up is sponsored by Crunchwell. Our lawyers say the crisps are not a weapon... ...yet.

emcee/mob.phase.lady_luck.1.heard: The understudy calls her lucky streak on stage.

emcee/rules.f10.arrive.heard: Welcome to the final curtain! Live in front of everybody. The crowd follows your height now. Keep it up, and they throw flowers. Let it drop, and they bring tomatoes.

emcee/rules.hint.wheel.heard: The wheel is picked the twist of this fight. It stays at the top of your screen until the room is clear.

emcee/sidekick.emcee.taken.1.heard: Our star just signed a co-star. Say hello to the new sidekick.

emcee/world.place.final_curtain.rule.heard: Live audience the crowd follows your hype flowers when they love you tomatoes when they do not three Champions then the producer

network/rules.shrine.used.heard: You already had your session here. The sponsors call this a wellness corner, not an all-you-can-eat buffet.

network/rules.signal.complete.heard: Every transmitter is live. The stairwells are back on air. Please, watch the edge on your way down.

ottoline/npc.dlg.ottoline.after.heard: Relief valves are not decorations, you know. One turn and the next peak is a minute late. Or turn it while sneaking and the steam goes into the nearest monster room.

vesper/npc.dlg.vesper.offer.heard: Quiet on set. Sorry. Habit, Vesper Hale, floor manager. I have run the studio for nine finales and the fan club has never been this loud. They are over the ropes and on my floor. Put 10 of them back behind the rope and the cameras might stop shaking.

emcee/arrive.arcade_zero.0.heard: Arcade zero the networks very first hit and it was never switched off You are incited now. Please do not tap on the glass

emcee/mob.intro.kill_screen.heard: Every game has a last level that was never meant to be played. Welcome to it, the kill screen. The floor is falling apart. Hit the cursor and keep the clock fed!

emcee/mob.intro.player_one.heard: The name at the top of every high score table since the cabinet was plugged in, Player One. Whatever you fight with, it fights with better. Bring your second best.

emcee/mob.intro.the_last_stage.heard: Nobody ever saw the end of this game. Here it is anyway, the last stage. It news by the pattern, and the pattern is drawn on the floor. Read the arrows!

emcee/mob.intro.the_motherboard.heard: Everything in this cabinet runs through her the motherboard the floor is her circuit pull the jumpers and shut her down part by part

emcee/world.place.arcade_zero.rule.heard: COMBO Kill in quick succession to build a multiplier on the walls. It pays corings and fame, and every five drops a token. Fall with one and you stand up again at the door. Power pads switch on underfoot. When the scan line sweeps, jump the low one, duck the high one. Clear every bonus cabinet to open the stairs.

dot/npc.dlg.dot.offer.heard: Do not look at the board, love, it is out of date. Todd Varga, for one week in a year, nobody remembers I was the top of that table. Then they all came back, the old high scores walking about like they own the place. Beat one of the district bosses for me and put my name back where it belongs.

gaffer/orientation.dress.rig.heard: Now the rig, sandbag over the dummy, rope tied off on that cleat, got it.

gaffer/orientation.dress.rig.again.heard: The cleat on the wall, cut the rope, the bag does the rest.

gaffer/orientation.dress.rig.done.heard: Tape on the floor means something comes down on it. Make sure it's them under it, not you.

gaffer/orientation.dress.search.heard: before the rat. See that rail glint? Hold your hand in it until you've found something.

gaffer/orientation.dress.search.again.heard: the rail by the wall. Keep your hand on it. Don't just poke it.

gaffer/orientation.dress.search.done.heard: Every crawler gets their own go at every drawer out there. Nobody's pinching yours.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.offer.heard: Mind the wires, they bite. Nibs Okafor, I service this cabinet. 30 years, I have kept it running. Lately, it runs me. The capacitors pop off the board. The fans walk about. The irons draw on the floor. Would you switch off eight of the loose parts for me?

dot/npc.dlg.dot.after.heard: The scan line comes low or high. Low, you jump. High, you duck. I spent 30 coins learning that.

dot/npc.dlg.dot.ready.heard: Look at the top of the table again and not a week too soon. Take this, it is the least a champion can do.

dot/npc.dlg.dot.thanks.heard: When you have a token in your pocket, you can afford to be brave. That is the whole secret. Do not tell the others.

dot/npc.dlg.dot.wait.heard: I have been practicing my signature. Three letters. It is harder than it looks.

kept.heard: And that is the spirit. Keep your combo going. The walls count it for you. Nobody ever counted for me.

emcee/arrive.arcade_zero.1.heard: Welcome to Arcade Zero, where the high scores are old, the monsters are older, and the coins never went out of fashion. Keep the combo going.

emcee/arrive.arcade_zero.2.heard: Arcade zero. Black screens, green boards, and the bright little world in the demo loop. Insert with self and press start.

emcee/mob.phase.kill_screen.1.heard: More rows are coming, the level is losing its grip and so is the cursor.

emcee/mob.phase.kill_screen.2.heard: The clock is the enemy now. Feed the slots and finish it!

emcee/mob.phase.player_one.1.heard: Player One has been watching your technique. Change it up!

emcee/mob.phase.player_one.2.heard: Player one is going for the record. Somebody break its streak!

emcee/mob.phase.the_last_stage.1.heard: Phase two. New arrows, same rule. Where they point, it goes.

emcee/mob.phase.the_last_stage.2.heard: Final phase it is fast now the arrows are still honest are your feet

emcee/mob.phase.the_motherboard.1.heard: She is bridging the jumpers again. Watch the sparks run along the traces and pull them back out.

emcee/mob.phase.the_motherboard.2.heard: Half her parts are dark and she is not taking it well. Keep those jumpers open!

emcee/setpiece.key.found.heard: A key fell off that one. The crew had copies cut for the whole cast and nobody fights over it. The lock in that room is yours.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.blast.0.heard: Set kill! It found out what the red crates are for. Pyrotechnics would like a word, then a raise.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.blast.1.heard: Boom. And it is off the call sheet. Somebody tell the Fire Marshal it was in the script.

kept.heard: Said Kale, that one took a stage light to the head. Lighting asks that you sign for it.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.drop.1.heard: Down comes the rig, out goes the monster, rigging will call it an accident, we will call it ratings.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.oil.0.heard: Set kill. It went for a paddle and burning oil. Props is not cleaning that up.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.pit.0.heard: Set, kill! It went through the stage floor and met the spikes. The understudy is on tonight!

emcee/setpiece.setkill.shock.0.heard: Set kill, it stood on a live grating. Electrics would like the record to show they warned everybody.

gaffer/orientation.hint.search.heard: That one glints. Hold your hand in it a moment, which you find is yours and your mates get their own go.

gaffer/orientation.hint.set_piece.heard: Tape on the floor. Something hanging. A crate marked red. The set is a weapon. Monsters under it, not you.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.after.heard: If the floor starts glowing under your boots, that is a power pad. Step on it. Free power. Do not tell accounts.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.ready.heard: Listen to that. A clean hum. That is the sound of a machine that knows its place here for the call-out fee.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.thanks.heard: Tit from the trade, a fan only blows down its own lane. Stand beside it, and it is just a draft.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.wait.heard: Something just walked past my toolbox on two legs. Components should not have legs.

nibs/npc.dlg.nibs.yes.heard: Lovely. When one of the little cans starts to crackle, step back. It is not angry, it is just full.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.oil.1.heard: One slick, one spark, one less monster, health and safety has fainted.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.pit.1.heard: Trapdoor. It exits down. Not the exit we rehearsed, but a classic.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.set.0.heard: Set kill! The set itself finished it. The designers are crying with joy.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.set.1.heard: The scenery got it, you pointed it in the right direction, and that counts.

emcee/setpiece.setkill.shock.1.heard: Sparks fly. and it stops flying. The fuse bot is now the most popular member of the cast.
